long_biography.plain_text:
Owners of a Sydney strata plan elected Malouf to their executive committee after she attended for GMPL Holdings in 2015. The appointment placed her in practical property governance: budgets, insurance, maintenance and common assets. The associated company remains active in New South Wales and owns commercial premises in the city centre.

A separate proposal brought Dana and Gerard Malouf together as applicants for housing on Marine Parade. Designed as four storeys above a landscaped basement podium, it contained ten one-, two- and three-bedroom homes. Three were reserved as affordable housing, adding mixed tenure to a small beachfront development.
